item.title: Bulletin updated at 20:00 HKT 08/Jan/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong easterly airstream will affect the coastal areas of Guangdong in the next few days. Meanwhile, a broad band of clouds will bring cloudy and rainy weather to the region. With the easterly airstream moderating, the weather is expected to be mild and humid over the coast of southern China in the latter part of this week, and there will be fog in the morning and at night. The northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China early next week. Temperatures over the region will fall appreciably.

Date/Month: 09/01 (Monday)
Wind: East to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground at first.
Weather: Cloudy with a few rain patches. Rain will be more frequent at night.
Temp range: 18 - 20 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium

Weather: Cloudy with rain.
